study type: Retrospective cohort study for machine learning model development and validation
exposure: Additional real-time data during the first stage of labor
cohort: The study included 94,480 cases of parturients in a tertiary referral center who attempted a trial of labor over a 12-year period.
finding: Real-time data acquired throughout the first stage of labor significantly increased the prediction accuracy for successful vaginal delivery using machine learning models.
mod_finding: The study's primary finding directly relates to mode of birth, showing that real-time data improves prediction accuracy for successful vaginal deliveries.
